title: German Potato Bowl
description: A hearty and comforting German-inspired dish, made with tender potatoes, crispy bacon, and a side of steamed vegetables.
instructions: 2. Peel the potatoes and cut them into 1-inch pieces. Place them in a bowl and drizzle with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
3. Spread the potatoes out in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and golden brown.
4. While the potatoes are roasting, heat the vegetable broth in a large saucepan over medium heat.
5. Add the sliced onion, carrots, and celery to the saucepan and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10-12 minutes.
6. To assemble the bowls, place a portion of the roasted potatoes in the bottom of each bowl, followed by a portion of the steamed vegetables.
